3cb2c546-ad2e-49b2-9bf8-5a76afd7ecce.name: Thoughtseize
rules: Target player reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card. You lose 2 life.

34109642-bdc0-483c-b90b-30184004b333.name: Radiation
rules: At the beginning of each player's precombat main phase, if that player has one or more rad counters, mill that many cards. For each nonland card milled this way, you lose 1 life and remove one rad counter.
